message: 学園四不思議
Now that exams are over, we can openly resume our Crusaders patrols, or so I thought.

name: Lolotte
message: 「If we're going to do it anyway, let's make it way more fun!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We're really just going for a stroll, after all.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Well? We have been studying nonstop. I suppose we could afford to be a little lenient!」

name: Ria
message: 「True. Turning everything into something fun is a wonderful idea.」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you sure about this, Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Why do you ask?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No... I just have a bad feeling about this」

name: Ria
message: 「It'll be fine. If anything happens, I'll properly back everyone up as your upperclassman. Ahem!」
Or so we laughed--until the moment passed.

name: Ria
message: 「A-A-A test of courage~?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes! While searching for demons, let's solve the academy's Seven Wonders at the same time!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh, so that's why it's a test of courage. Sounds fun! So, what are the academy's Seven Wonders--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I made sure to borrow this from the library. Behold, 'The 7 Wonders of Ryuusei Academy: 1300 Edition'!」

name: Misa
message: 「The year 1300... meaning last year's was different? And what's more, the author and supervisor is Helena Kujou...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa, sounds super half-baked!」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Sis... what kind of book did you write...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it's the latest issue, at least. Let's see here...」

name: Ria
message: 「A-Are we really doing a test of courage~? That kind of thing is a little...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're gonna back us up good, right, Ria-senpai♪」

name: Misa
message: 「To be protected by Big Sister...\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Uuu~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, everyone. Let's transform right away and let's go!!」

name: Synn
message: 「One of the academy's Seven Wonders...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gulp...」

name: Synn
message: 「Actually, there are only three mysteries」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh, now that's a mystery!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Phew...」

name: Misa
message: 「Then why are we at the pool?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Apparently, one of the three happens right here in this pool」

name: Synn
message: 「A pool that's supposed to be completely empty. Yet every now and then, the sound of splashing echoes through it」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh, s... so that's why we're at the pool?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-We're here right now, though, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, but none of us are in the water, so weird splashing sounds--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I just heard something...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No way, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「A-Aaaah, over there...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「A figure!!」
「...Who's there?」

name: Everyone
message: 「Kyaaaa!!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, e-everyone...!?」
I tried to run away with them, but something grabbed me and I couldn't move a muscle.

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way, a ghost...!? Ugyaaa!!」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I'm sorry... My legs... won't move...」

name: Synn
message: 「L-Ria-senpai...?」
There's no way I can just leave Ria-senpai behind like this.
Still, taking on a ghost is tough even for the Demon Lord... wait, that's so weak!!

name: Azel
message: 「What are you doing there」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Azel...?」

name: Ria
message: 「O-oh, it's just you, Azel... Phew, you scared me」

name: Azel
message: 「Why...? How were you able to get in here...? Could it be...」

name: Synn
message: 「We're just doing a normal patrol, though... What about you, Azel? What are you doing?」

name: Azel
message: 「...taking a walk」

name: Synn
message: 「A walk...?」

name: Ria
message: 「J-jeez! You shouldn't be taking a walk around the pool this late at night!」
No, it feels like there's something way more important to point out than that.

name: Azel
message: 「Hmph...」

name: Ria
message: 「W-what is it!」

name: Azel
message: 「Your legs are shaking」
Saying that, Azel walked away.

name: Synn
message: 「Are you okay, Ria-senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I'm fine... Thanks, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone ran away, too... What should we do about this?」

name: Ria
message: 「At the very least, this means one of the Seven Wonders is solved, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, there's only one left anyway」

name: Ria
message: 「I can't help thinking she prepared this book just to put me through something like this...」

name: Synn
message: 「W-well, it is Helena-san we're talking about...」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn!! Let's solve the last mystery, too. Once we do, my big sister's prank will finally be over!」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you sure about this, though?」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I'm not scared at all! You're the one who's scared, Synn!」
Geesh, she really can't be honest with herself...

name: Synn
message: 「M-Maybe we really should call it off...」

name: Ria
message: 「What if it's a Demon? That'd be a huge problem.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, well, if it's a ghost, that'd be an even bigger problem!」

name: Ria
message: 「It'll be fine!」
Look at Ria-senpai, getting all worked up...
Don't blame me if your legs give out on you again.

name: Synn
message: 「When night falls, Finis Tower is shrouded in truly terrifying, bizarre shadows.」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm sure it's Sally this time, I just know it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Just because it was Azel earlier doesn't mean it'll be her now.」

name: Ria
message: 「No means no!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're not making any sense anymore...」
This area is creepy enough on its own, so adding ghost stories on top of it just makes the dread pile up even more.
Honestly, with an atmosphere like this, it wouldn't be weird at all if a ghost popped out...
Ria-senpai's tough act is only on her face--her body is trembling in tiny shivers.
She was only supposed to be pinching the hem of my clothes, yet before I knew it, she had grabbed onto my arm.
And then--

name: Ria
message: 「N-Nobody's here, right...?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's what this patrol is for... Urgh.」
Ria-senpai clung tightly to my arm!
Unlike when we're in our uniforms, today she's pressed up against me in her combat outfit.
If I turn toward Ria-senpai even a little, I end up catching sight of her pale, swelling skin.
--No, stop it, stop it!
Still, if the cloth covering her chest were to flip right down like this...

name: Ria
message: 「Shh!!」

name: Ria
message: 「...I sense... a presence...」
Ria-senpai puts on a serious expression.
Even so, I can't help being way more preoccupied with Ria-senpai's chest.

name: Synn
message: 「...I'll go take a quick look.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah... S-Synn-kun! Please... don't leave me behind...」
When I shook off Ria-senpai's arm, she stopped me.

name: Synn
message: 「A-All right, I got it.」
While looking away, I tried to slip my arm back between Ria-senpai's arms, when--
Squish. A soft sensation pressed against my arm.

name: Ria
message: 「Kya... Kyaaa!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm sorry!!」
Ria-senpai frantically covered her chest with both arms, right where I had accidentally touched her.
Pushed up like that, they look even bigger!

name: Ria
message: 「J-Jeez! What are you doing all of a sudden?!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No! It was just so dark I couldn't see well...」

name: Ria
message: 「You pervert, Synn-kun!」
Ah, Ria-senpai hates me now...

name: Ria
message: 「Even if you are a boy, if you do things like this, girls are going to hate you, you know.」
She gave my forehead a light poke.

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sorry, I was careless...」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, it's fine. Just promise you'll never do it again. Got it?」
Even as I nodded, my eyes drifted toward Senpai's chest as she struck a scolding pose...
Just then, a shadow suddenly blocked my view.

name: Synn
message: 「Mist...?」
Aw, that incredible view just got swallowed up by black smoke!
Wait, no, snap out of it!

name: Synn
message: 「R-Ria-senpai... u-um...」

name: Ria
message: 「S-So the school's Seven Mysteries really are...」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No way... I knew it, a gh-ghost!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!?」
Suddenly losing her composure, Ria-senpai lunges at me without a moment's hesitation.

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!」
And pressed against my arm is an indescribably soft twin-peaked mountain!

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, man...」

name: Ria
message: 「Sh-Synn-kun!?」
The tighter Senpai clings to me, the further my consciousness slips away.
Search the entire world over, and you wouldn't find hills surpassing these peaks.
This truly is the highest summit!

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, that's not it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, um, could you back up just a little bit?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's just, y-y-your ch-chest, uh, umm!」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, we don't have time for that right now! We have to hurry and run or we'll get cursed!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm telling you, if we don't do something about this, I'm the one who's gonna lose it!」
「Who's there!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Kyaaaa!!」
Whoever that voice belongs to, getting caught like this would be really bad!
Still pressed tightly together, we bolted at full speed.
In the end, almost all of the Seven Mysteries remained mysteries.

name: Lolotte
message: 「So, what happened to that red handprint on your face?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's one of the Seven Mysteries.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmph, I don't care anymore!」
